prosecutor_output.executive_summary: The repository Adomat1/-commoners-code contains a single file (index.html.rtf) that serves as a portfolio and Anthropic Console verification page. The file is stored in RTF format, rendering it non-functional as HTML. The page describes three projects and a tooling suite, none of which exist in the repository. Contact information uses placeholder values. The repository has had no development activity since its initial commit on 2025-10-19.
key_findings: FINDING 1: The repository's sole file is in RTF format, not HTML. It cannot serve its stated purpose as a web page without format conversion. [AUD-001, AUD-007]

FINDING 2: The portfolio page describes two publications (The Commoner's Ledger, The Commoner's Code Field Manual I) and a tooling suite (Bash/npm CLI for PDF generation) — none of which are present in the repository. [AUD-003, AUD-004]
FINDING 3: Contact and verification details use template placeholders (hello@your-domain.tld), undermining the page's stated purpose as a developer verification page. [AUD-002]
FINDING 4: The repository lacks all standard project infrastructure and has been inactive for approximately 5 months. [AUD-005, AUD-006]
prosecutor_output.legal_position: The repository in its current state does not substantiate the claims made on its portfolio page. No evidence of the described publications, tooling, or active development exists within the repository. The verification page contains placeholder contact details and is stored in a non-functional format. The gap between claims and evidence is complete — no partial work, drafts, or tooling artifacts are present.
